The S5 known-red image: the migration harness with a deliberately
broken migration installed (omarchy-broken-migration — a migration
that never creates its marker, so it stays pending forever). The
migrate-no-pending check MUST FAIL — proving the harness catches a
broken migration. Expected to fail by design.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `omarchy-broken-migration`
